title: [MODERN Victorian] Skyscraper Building (at WOK) & 85 SUBS THANK YOU!
author: Rolofolo

generated.description: A tall, narrow-looking office tower in a modern Victorian style, built mostly from snow blocks and sandstone with glass windows and a dark stone base. It stands about 43 wide, 62 high and 40 deep, with a stepped top and a few small rooftop details, and the interior holds chests, a furnace, beacons and signs. It is a large build with roughly 26,000 blocks, best suited to a city or snowy/desert-edge setting.
